summary: Exclude the standalone Grand Falls-Windsor source task as a non-distinct underlying facility already represented by the existing canonical Gander and Grand Falls-Windsor Care Homes Project record. Fresh direct evidence verifies that one Project Agreement and one ProjectCo, Fengate Central Health, LP, cover both 60-bed homes. This resolves the source-task identity without a database or seed mutation. The model recommended SUPERSEDED, but the execution contract permits that status only when another source task is the replacement; no such task exists in the 496-task manifest, while the canonical production company predates and exists outside this source-task queue. EXCLUDED therefore preserves the substantive finding without inventing a replacement task ID. The current ProjectCo cap table remains unresolved and must remain an exact exception on the canonical record: no direct source names all limited partners, beneficial owners, percentages or the exact Fengate fund/vehicle, and procurement-stage labels do not prove whether SEC Pomerleau subscribed, retained or transferred equity.
resolvedFormerBlockers: The final government value-for-money assessment directly identifies one Project Agreement and one ProjectCo, Fengate Central Health, LP, for both the Gander and Grand Falls-Windsor care homes.

The final assessment directly identifies funds managed by Fengate Capital Management Ltd. as project risk-capital provider, Pomerleau Inc. as design-builder and TD Securities as debt underwriter, preventing those roles from being collapsed.
The current government project page and procurement-stage shortlist directly verify the two-home bundle and explain the source of the conflicting SEC Pomerleau equity-provider label.

Fengate's direct financial-close release and Pomerleau's direct project page independently corroborate that the two facilities form one project and separate the sponsor/developer and constructor roles.

The direct official CADO search and detail pages verify that Fengate Central Health GP Inc., company number 84100, is active and was registered in Newfoundland and Labrador on 2019-06-05, while supplying no legal link to the ProjectCo LP.
The source queue contains no separate canonical Gander-project task to use as a replacement, while production company cmrxpjfba00x0ivhealbde already represents the consolidated project.
